See also: lilas, Lilas, lîlas, lilàs, and lila's

Hungarian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

lila (“purple”) +‎ -s (“-ish”, adjective-forming suffix)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈlilaːʃ]
  • Hyphenation: li‧lás
  • Rhymes: -aːʃ

Adjective

[edit]

lilás (comparative lilásabb, superlative leglilásabb)

  1. purplish (somewhat purple in color)
